  Public Works Commission/  1.A.
  Public Safety Commission
  Agenda Report
To:  Members of the Public Works Commission and Public Safety
  Commission

Prepared by:  Rob DuBoux, Public Works Director/City Engineer

Approved by:  Steve McClary, City Manager

Date prepared:  June 17, 2024  Meeting date: June 26, 2024

Subject:  Pacific Coast Highway Master Plan

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive presentation from Caltrans on the proposed Pacific
Coast Highway (PCH) Master Plan.

DISCUSSION: The City and Caltrans continue to work collaboratively on a variety of PCH
traffic safety improvement projects. The City currently has one project in construction, five
projects in the design phase, and one project completed. Caltrans also has several traffic
safety projects in development. A new pedestrian signal upgrade near 22483 PCH will be
under construction later this year and two major improvement projects within Malibu is
currently in project development stage. Caltrans is also working on a $4.25 million Caltrans
“Director's Order” project that includes a variety of traffic safety improvements on PCH.
That work is expected to be completed in Summer 2024.

Lastly, Caltrans will be conducting a Master Plan on PCH. The focus of the PCH Master
Plan Feasibility Study is to identify transportation improvements that will address safety
for all users, including multimodal travel options for pedestrians and bicyclists, as well as
enhancing transit opportunities. This master plan will include stakeholder engagement
activities and community outreach meetings to solicit input on various traffic calming
measures and other street improvements, including a “boulevard” type roadway. This
master plan will be used in future PCH safety improvement projects.

Caltrans will provide the Commissions with a presentation on the proposed PCH Master
Plan as part of their community engagement to receive feedback from the residents.
